examples.description: Kicker density against an explicit baseline rate

artifacts: JSON envelope with per-paragraph kicker classifications and the density (stdout or --out)

purpose: AIC-9 (Closure Inflation) detector. Classifies paragraph-final sentences as kicker-shaped (short, declarative, generalizable, period-final) with a confidence score, and reports the share of paragraphs that close on a kicker, optionally against an operator-supplied baseline rate.
use_when: essayistic prose seems to end paragraphs on quotable summary lines and you want the rate measured
checking whether a revision pass added kicker closings (run before and after)
